job.title: Commercial Mobile Plumber
job.description:
Mobile Commercial Plumber – FM Service Provider – London/M25 – Up to £50,000 + Package

CBW Staffing Solutions are currently recruiting for a Mobile Commercial Plumber to carry out planned and reactive commercial maintenance in and around London & the M25. The successful candidate will have a strong understanding of plumbing in facilities maintenance and have a proven track record in commercial building maintenance. In return, the company are offering a competitive salary of up to £50,000 with a potential route into further career progression.

Hours of Work & Package Information

  • Basic Salary of up to £50,000
  • Monday to Friday 08.00 – 17.00
  • 25 days holiday + Bank Holidays
  • Company Vehicle + Fuel Card
  • Callout 1 in 5 - Standby £100 P/W
  • Full company uniform
  • PDA and Mobile phone
  • Pension
Key Duties & Responsibilities

  • Carry out commercial pipework installation, maintenance and repairs.
  • Undertake press-fit pipework and soldering.
  • Remove and replace calorifiers and water heaters.
  • Maintain, repair and replace pumps.
  • Maintain and service pressurisation units.
  • Carry out fault-finding and repairs on commercial water systems.
Requirements

  • Plumbing - City & Guilds Level 2 (Essential)
  • Domestic or Commercial Gas tickets (Advantageous but not needed)
  • Full driver’s licence
  • A proven track record in commercial building maintenance
  • Good communication skills
  • Client Facing
Please send your CV to Archie Reed of CBW Staffing Solutions to avoid missing the opportunity.

job.title: Electrical Shift Engineer
job.description:
Electrical Shift Maintenance Engineer – FM Service Provider – Chancery Lane, London – £56,000 Package + HVAP

CBW Staffing Solutions is recruiting for a leading FM service provider seeking a Shift Electrical Maintenance Engineer to join a flagship, multi-tenanted commercial building on Chancery Lane, London.

This is an excellent opportunity for an electrically qualified engineer with HVAP status or the ambition to achieve it, working on a site with a strong focus on plant reliability, safety and career development.

Hours of Work:
  • Continental shift pattern – 4 on, 4 off
  • 07:00–19:00, covering days and nights

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Carry out planned preventative and reactive maintenance across electrical systems, including distribution boards, switchgear, UPS, generators, lighting and power circuits.
  • Diagnose faults and complete repairs across electrical and associated building services systems.
  • Support HV safety and compliance, working in line with LOTO procedures where authorised.
  • Monitor the BMS and respond to system alarms.
  • Assist with mechanical and HVAC maintenance when required.
  • Work within the Permit to Work system and support statutory compliance.
  • Oversee specialist subcontractors carrying out electrical works.
  • Maintain site logbooks, RAMS and accurate maintenance records.
  • Keep plant rooms and equipment clean, safe and operational.
  • Complete near-miss reports and maintain high health and safety standards.

Package:
  • £48,000 basic salary
  • £5,000 shift allowance
  • £3,000 HVAP payment
  • Total package up to £56,000
  • Generous holiday entitlement
  • Overtime opportunities
  • Private healthcare options
  • Stakeholder pension scheme
  • Ongoing training, HVAP courses and electrical CPD
  • Long-term career progression on a flagship commercial contract

Requirements:
  • City & Guilds / NVQ Level 3 in Electrical Installation or equivalent.
  • HVAP status, or a genuine willingness to work towards it.
  • Strong experience in commercial building services maintenance.
  • Good knowledge of BMS and CAFM systems; Maximo experience is advantageous.
  • Ability to interpret electrical schematics and fault-find under pressure.
  • A proactive, safety-conscious approach with strong communication skills.

Interested? Please send your CV to Bailey White at CBW Staffing Solutions to apply for this opportunity.

job.title: Maintenance Electrician
job.description:
Site based Maintenance Electrician - Cramlington - Global Facilities Management Organisation: FMCG

CBW Staffing Solutions are seeking a skilled Maintenance Electrician to join our client on a permanent basis, who are a leading provider in facilities management solutions, delivering top-tier services across FMCG/commercial industries.

The ideal candidate will have a strong background in electrical maintenance within commercial settings, as they will be responsible for diagnosing, repairing, and maintaining electrical systems and equipment to ensure optimal functionality and safety.

This is a site based opportunity, located in Cramlington.

Package
  • Competitive salary up to £39,000 per annum (depending on experience)
  • Core hours are Monday - Friday (40 hours per week)
  • Participation in 'out of hours' on call rota
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Generous workplace pension scheme
  • Training, development & progression opportunities
Responsibilities
  • Conduct routine inspections of electrical systems to identify and resolve issues promptly
  • Perform preventive maintenance tasks to minimise downtime and ensure the longevity of electrical equipment
  • Troubleshoot electrical faults and implement effective solutions to restore functionality
  • Install, repair, and maintain electrical components, such as wiring, circuit breakers, and lighting fixtures
  • Collaborate with other maintenance personnel and contractors to coordinate repairs and upgrades
  • Adhere to safety protocols and regulations to create a secure working environment
Qualifications
  • Qualified to at least City & Guilds Level 3 in Electrical Installation or equivalent
  • Proven experience as a Maintenance Electrician or similar role within the facilities management industry
  • Strong knowledge of electrical systems, wiring, and circuitry
  • Proficiency in diagnosing and repairing electrical faults
  • Familiarity with electrical codes and regulations
  • Ability to read technical diagrams and blueprints
  • Excellent problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Effective communication and teamwork abilities
If you are a dedicated Maintenance Electrician looking for a rewarding career opportunity, please apply with your full CV or contact Amy O'Shea at CBW Staffing Solutions.

job.title: Mechanical Maintenance Engineer
job.description:
Mechanical Maintenance Engineer – Client Direct – Commercial Office – Aldgate, London – £49,000 + Bonus

CBW Staffing Solutions is recruiting for a Mechanical Maintenance Engineer to join a client-direct, in-house maintenance team at a prestigious commercial office building in Aldgate, City of London.

This is an excellent opportunity to join an established in-house team, offering a competitive salary, an attractive benefits package and ongoing training and career progression. The successful candidate will have a mechanical bias and proven experience in commercial building maintenance, ideally within a critical environment such as a bank, data centre or blue-chip office.

Hours of Work:
  • Monday to Friday
  • 08:30–17:30

Key Duties & Responsibilities:
  • Carry out planned and reactive mechanical maintenance across the building.
  • Respond to helpdesk and Service Desk requests in line with agreed SLAs.
  • Undertake plumbing and public health maintenance, including blocked toilets and minor repairs.
  • Investigate and resolve heating, cooling and air conditioning complaints.
  • Operate the Building Management System (BMS) and Lighting Control System (LCS).
  • Complete water hygiene and treatment tasks in accordance with L8 procedures and site logbooks.
  • Maintain plant rooms, ensuring equipment and working areas remain clean and presentable.
  • Carry out minor fabric maintenance, including painting and furniture moves.
  • Assist with minor mechanical installations under supervision.
  • Respond to building alarms, escalating issues where necessary and recording reactive tasks in the shift log.
  • Escort contractors and ensure site working procedures are followed.
  • Support quarterly inspections carried out by the water treatment consultant.
  • Report risks, accidents and near misses promptly.
  • Deliver a high standard of customer service and maintain accurate maintenance records.

Package:
  • £49,000 salary + bonus
  • 26 days annual leave + bank holidays
  • 7.5% employer pension contribution
  • BUPA private medical and dental cover, with family upgrade available
  • Employee Assistance Programme (EAP)
  • Health assessments every two years
  • Life assurance at four times salary
  • Income protection and critical illness insurance
  • Travel insurance and will-writing service
  • Annual eyesight tests and flu vaccinations
  • Enhanced family leave pay
  • Sponsorship for professional and educational studies
  • Industry-leading training and development
  • Retail, travel and entertainment discounts and cashback

Requirements:
  • Mechanical or electrical qualification at Level 2, Level 3, HNC or HND.
  • Copies of relevant trade certificates must be available.
  • Proven experience in commercial building maintenance.
  • Strong customer service and communication skills.

Desirable Experience:
  • Additional electrical, air conditioning or other relevant qualifications.
  • Experience within a bank, data centre or commercial office environment.
  • Current or expired high-voltage experience or qualifications.
  • Previous experience working rotating day and night shifts.

Interested? Please contact Bailey White at CBW Staffing Solutions to discuss the opportunity and apply.

job.title: Shift Handyperson
job.description:
Shift-Based Handyperson - Birmingham - Global Facilities Management Organisation: FMCG

CBW Staffing Solutions are looking for two experienced and reliable Handypersons to join our client’s on-site facilities team based in Birmingham.

You’ll be responsible for carrying out reactive repairs to the building fabric, plumbing and sanitaryware replacements, and small-scale groundworks such as repointing, levelling paving slabs and fence repairs. You’ll also undertake minor joinery and decoration work, and assist with office or desk moves when required.

This is a varied, hands-on role within a busy FMCG environment, ensuring the site remains safe, fully operational and well maintained.

We have two opportunities available, working a shift pattern of 4 on 4 off, 10am–10pm.

Package
  • Competitive salary of up to £40,000 per annum
  • 4 on 4 off shift pattern
  • Working hours: 10am–10pm
  • Out-of-hours on-call rota (TBC)
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Training, development & progression opportunities
Responsibilities
  • Carry out reactive building fabric repairs
  • Perform general plumbing repairs and replace sanitaryware, including taps and toilet components
  • Complete basic groundworks and landscaping repairs, including repointing, paving and fence repairs
  • Undertake minor joinery and decoration works
  • Support office moves and furniture relocations
  • Ensure the site remains safe, tidy and presentable
  • Carry out general site cleaning duties when required
  • Respond to maintenance requests and ensure work is completed efficiently and to a high standard
Requirements
  • Minimum 2 years' experience in a similar maintenance or handyperson role
  • Strong background in commercial building maintenance
  • Good problem-solving skills and attention to detail
  • Physically able to meet the demands of the role, including lifting, climbing and standing for extended periods
  • Ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • Flexible approach to working within a shift-based environment
If you're an experienced Handyperson looking for a new challenge within a stable and well-established facilities management organisation, we'd love to hear from you.

job.title: Facilities Finance Administrator
job.description:
Facilities Finance Administrator - Coventry - Global Facilities Management Organisation

We are seeking an organised Contract Support (Finance) to support the day-to-day financial and administrative running of a key facilities management contract within the water industry.

The ideal candidate will have previous administration or contract support experience, good financial awareness and strong attention to detail. Experience within FM, construction or building services would be advantageous.

This is a predominantly office-based role, ideally suited to someone based in or around Coventry, with occasional travel to Bristol when required.

Package
  • Salary of £30,000 – £35,000 per annum, depending on experience
  • Core hours are Monday - Friday (40 hours per week)
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Generous workplace pension scheme
  • Training, development & progression opportunities
Responsibilities
  • Manage the day-to-day financial administration of the contract
  • Raise and manage work orders, ensuring information is accurate and jobs are correctly closed
  • Process purchase orders and deal with supplier and contractor queries
  • Prepare and submit client invoices, ensuring accurate and timely billing
  • Check supplier invoices and resolve any discrepancies
  • Monitor outstanding costs, payments and billing activity
  • Track additional works from quotation through to completion and invoicing
  • Maintain financial trackers and spreadsheets to support contract reporting
  • Work closely with operational teams to ensure the smooth running of the contract
Qualifications
  • Previous experience in administration, contract support or a finance-related role
  • Experience within FM, construction or building services would be advantageous
  • Good financial acumen and confidence handling invoices, costs and purchase orders
  • No formal finance qualifications required
  • Strong Microsoft Excel skills
  • Excellent attention to detail and organisational skills
  • Confident communication skills when dealing with contractors, suppliers and colleagues
  • Ability to manage workloads independently and work to deadlines
  • Proactive approach with a strong team mentality
If you are an experienced Administrator or Contract Support professional with good financial awareness and are looking for your next opportunity, we would love to hear from you.

job.title: Maintenance Electrician
job.description:
Site based Maintenance Electrician - Wetherby - Global Facilities Management Organisation

CBW Staffing Solutions are currently recruiting for a Maintenance Electrician to join a facilities management team at a site in Wetherby.

This is an excellent opportunity for an electrically qualified engineer looking to develop their career, with a clear progression route into a High Voltage (HV) Electrician position. Full training and relevant HV qualifications will be fully funded by the employer.

The successful candidate will be responsible for carrying out planned and reactive electrical maintenance across the site, ensuring all electrical systems and equipment are maintained to a high standard.

Package
  • Competitive salary up to £44,000 per annum (depending on experience)
  • Participation in an 'out of hours' on call rota
  • 25 days annual leave plus bank holidays
  • Generous workplace pension scheme
  • Training, development & progression opportunities

Responsibilities
  • Carry out planned preventative maintenance (PPM) and reactive maintenance on electrical systems
  • Diagnose and repair electrical faults across the site
  • Ensure all electrical maintenance is completed in line with health and safety regulations
  • Assist with general building services maintenance where required
  • Complete maintenance records and ensure all work is accurately documented
  • Support the wider engineering team in maintaining the site's electrical infrastructure
  • Undertake full HV training and qualifications, progressing towards an HV Electrician position

Requirements
  • NVQ Level 3 or equivalent in Electrical Installation or Electrical Maintenance
  • Previous experience in electrical maintenance, ideally within facilities management or a commercial environment
  • Good fault-finding and diagnostic skills
  • Knowledge of planned and reactive maintenance
  • A proactive approach with the ability to work independently and as part of a team
  • A genuine interest in developing a career within high voltage engineering

Interested? Apply with a full & up to date CV or contact Amy O'Shea at CBW Staffing Solutions.

job.title: Domestic Gas Engineer
job.description:

CBW are currently recruiting for an experienced Resident Liaison Officer to join a leading Renewables team based in Inverness.

The role is focused on ensuring residents are kept fully informed, supported and engaged before, during and after works take place. The successful candidate will build strong relationships with residents, respond to queries and concerns, coordinate information with project teams, and help minimise disruption associated with construction activities.

This is a Inverness based position with regular travel throughout the north of Scotland, reflecting the geographical spread of current and future projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the principal contact for residents throughout the lifecycle of works.
  • Provide clear, accurate and timely information regarding planned works, programme dates, access requirements, progress and completion.
  • Build positive and professional relationships with residents, maintaining trust and confidence throughout the project.
  • Identify resident concerns at an early stage and ensure appropriate action is taken.
  • Communicate changes to programmes, working arrangements or planned activities promptly.
  • Ensure residents understand what to expect before, during and following works to their property or communal areas.
  • Undertake regular visits to properties and residential areas affected by project activities.
  • Engage directly with residents to understand their experience and identify any issues requiring attention.
  • Record and follow up resident queries, requests and concerns through to resolution.
  • Identify individual circumstances or additional support requirements and ensure these are communicated to the appropriate members of the project team.
  • Arrange and participate in resident information meetings, briefings and engagement sessions.
  • Prepare and distribute relevant project information and updates.
  • Support residents in understanding project schedules, key milestones and expected completion dates.
  • Receive and manage resident complaints and concerns in a professional and constructive manner.
  • Work with the relevant project, site and management personnel to investigate and resolve issues.
  • Keep residents informed of progress where an issue cannot be resolved immediately.
  • Monitor outstanding matters and ensure appropriate follow-up takes place.
  • Escalate significant, recurring or unresolved issues to the appropriate level of management.
  • Report hazards, incidents, environmental concerns or other matters requiring management attention.
Person Specification:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish positive relationships with a wide range of people.
  • A professional, approachable and empathetic manner.
  • Strong listening skills and the ability to understand and respond appropriately to resident concerns.
  • Effective problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with challenging situations.
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple enquiries, priorities and deadlines.
  • Good attention to detail and accurate record keeping.
  • Previous experience in a resident-facing, customer service, community engagement or similar role.
  • Experience within construction, housing, property, facilities management, refurbishment or a related environment would be advantageous.
  • Understanding of the challenges and sensitivities associated with working in occupied residential properties.
  • Experience of handling customer complaints, enquiries or service issues.
  • Familiarity with maintaining electronic records and using digital systems.

Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £35,000 DOE
  • Van and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.

job.title: Mechanical Plumber

job.title: Heating Engineer
job.description:

We are currently recruiting for an experienced Heating Service Engineer to join a growing engineering team.

This is a mobile, field-based position, primarily covering the West of Scotland, with occasional travel across Scotland and, where required, other parts of the UK.

The role offers the opportunity to work across a varied range of domestic and commercial heating systems, with additional training available in renewable technologies including biomass boilers and heat pump systems.

Key Responsibilities:
  • Carry out planned servicing and maintenance of domestic and commercial heating systems.
  • Attend reactive breakdowns and diagnose faults across a range of heating equipment.
  • Complete repairs and maintenance safely, efficiently and to a high standard.
  • Work on gas and oil-fired appliances, heating systems and associated equipment.

  • Install heating appliances, pipework and associated ancillary equipment.
  • Carry out fault finding and problem solving across mechanical and heating systems.
  • Ensure all work is completed in accordance with Gas Safety Regulations, health & safety requirements and relevant industry standards.

  • Experience working with domestic and commercial heating systems.

  • A relevant SVQ, City & Guilds or equivalent qualification.
  • Strong practical experience in heating, gas, oil or mechanical engineering.

  • Strong communication and customer service skills.
  • A full UK driving licence.
Desirable Experience: Experience with any of the following would be advantageous:

  • Biomass boilers and fuel delivery systems.
  • Air source and ground source heat pumps.
  • OFTEC qualifications.
  • Renewable heating technologies.
  • Commercial heating installations.
Salary & Benefits:
  • Permanent, full-time position paying up to £47,000 DOE
  • Company vehicle and fuel card.
  • 30 days' annual leave.
  • Company pension scheme.
  • Monday–Thursday: 08:00–16:30.
  • Friday: 08:00–15:30.

  • Opportunity to develop skills in renewable heating technologies.

  • Supportive working environment with opportunities for career development.

job.title: Tenant Liaison Officer
job.description:
Tenant Liaison Officer - Inverness - Salary up to £35,000 DOE

CBW are currently recruiting for an experienced Resident Liaison Officer to join a leading Renewables team based in Inverness.

The role is focused on ensuring residents are kept fully informed, supported and engaged before, during and after works take place. The successful candidate will build strong relationships with residents, respond to queries and concerns, coordinate information with project teams, and help minimise disruption associated with construction activities.

This is a Inverness based position with regular travel throughout the north of Scotland, reflecting the geographical spread of current and future projects.

Key Responsibilities:

  • Act as the principal contact for residents throughout the lifecycle of works.
  • Provide clear, accurate and timely information regarding planned works, programme dates, access requirements, progress and completion.
  • Build positive and professional relationships with residents, maintaining trust and confidence throughout the project.
  • Identify resident concerns at an early stage and ensure appropriate action is taken.
  • Communicate changes to programmes, working arrangements or planned activities promptly.
  • Ensure residents understand what to expect before, during and following works to their property or communal areas.
  • Undertake regular visits to properties and residential areas affected by project activities.
  • Engage directly with residents to understand their experience and identify any issues requiring attention.
  • Record and follow up resident queries, requests and concerns through to resolution.
  • Identify individual circumstances or additional support requirements and ensure these are communicated to the appropriate members of the project team.
  • Arrange and participate in resident information meetings, briefings and engagement sessions.
  • Prepare and distribute relevant project information and updates.
  • Support residents in understanding project schedules, key milestones and expected completion dates.
  • Receive and manage resident complaints and concerns in a professional and constructive manner.
  • Work with the relevant project, site and management personnel to investigate and resolve issues.
  • Keep residents informed of progress where an issue cannot be resolved immediately.
  • Monitor outstanding matters and ensure appropriate follow-up takes place.
  • Escalate significant, recurring or unresolved issues to the appropriate level of management.
  • Report hazards, incidents, environmental concerns or other matters requiring management attention.
Person Specification:

  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
  • Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to establish positive relationships with a wide range of people.
  • A professional, approachable and empathetic manner.
  • Strong listening skills and the ability to understand and respond appropriately to resident concerns.
  • Effective problem-solving and conflict-resolution skills.
  • Ability to remain calm and professional when dealing with challenging situations.
  • Strong organisational and administrative skills.
  • Ability to manage multiple enquiries, priorities and deadlines.
  • Good attention to detail and accurate record keeping.
  • Previous experience in a resident-facing, customer service, community engagement or similar role.
  • Experience within construction, housing, property, facilities management, refurbishment or a related environment would be advantageous.
  • Understanding of the challenges and sensitivities associated with working in occupied residential properties.
  • Experience of handling customer complaints, enquiries or service issues.
  • Familiarity with maintaining electronic records and using digital systems.

Salary & Benefits:

  • Salary up to £35,000 DOE
  • Van and fuel card.
  • Ongoing training and professional development.
  • Career progression within a growing renewable energy business.
  • Company pension.
  • Supportive team environment with a strong focus on quality, safety and continuous improvement.
